children: The Canadian dollar strengthened against the greenback on Monday, and the yield on benchmark government debt climbed.
was trading 0.2% higher at C$1.3879 to the greenback, or 72.05 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3881 to 1.3911.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) rose 2.3 basis points to 3.749%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.752%.
futures rose $2.76 to $86.16 a barrel on Monday.
